name: Compute Cluster
description: SLURM compute-cluster integration over a tailnet. Owns /api/cluster/{settings,hosts,test-ssh,ssh-key} HTTP routes, cluster settings UI, and the ref-compute-cluster knowledge node. Depends on Tailscale for private network reachability and ssh-sidecar for sidecar-owned cluster SSH credentials. Reads cluster config from the host slot (clusterUsername/LoginHost/TmuxPrefix/Hosts) populated by SPORE_CLUSTER_* env vars.
